title: Umami Prosciutto Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and savory stir fry made with prosciutto, noodles, and umami flavor.
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Heat sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add prosciutto and cook until crispy, about 2 minutes.
Add umami sauce and stir to combine.
Add cooked noodles and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until coated with sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
